title: Approximating Uniform Random Rotations by Two-Stage Structured Hadamard Rotations in High Dimensions
abstract: arXiv:2604.23418v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Uniform random rotations are useful in fast Johnson--Lindenstrauss embeddings, kernel approximation, communication-efficient learning, and recent AI compression pipelines, but are computationally expensive to generate and apply in high dimensions. A practical alternative repeats Walsh--Hadamard transforms with random sign diagonals.   Applying this structured rotation twice has shown empirical benefits, but supporting theory remains limited. We study the approximation quality of the two-stage structured Hadamard rotation. Here $d$ is the dimension of the rotated vector. On the positive side, we prove explicit, nonasymptotic upper bounds of order $\sqrt{\log d/d}$ in both Kolmogorov and Wasserstein-1 distance for corresponding coordinates scaled by $\sqrt d$, uniformly over unit inputs and coordinates. translated_abstract: 均匀随机旋转在快速Johnson--Lindenstrauss嵌入、核近似、通信高效学习以及近期AI压缩流程中非常有用，但在高维空间中生成和应用这些旋转的计算成本很高。一种实用的替代方法是重复使用带有随机符号对角矩阵的Walsh--Hadamard变换。将该结构化旋转应用两次已在实证中显示出优势，但支持该做法的理论仍然有限。我们研究了两阶段结构化Hadamard旋转的逼近质量，其中 $d$ 是被旋转向量的维度。从积极方面来看，我们证明了在Kolmogorov距离和Wasserstein-1距离下，对于经过 $\sqrt d$ 缩放的对应坐标，在所有单位输入和坐标上一致成立的显式非渐近上界，其阶为 $\sqrt{\log d/d}$。对于输入 $u=e_1$，两种距离在每个坐标处也存在阶为 $d^{-1/2}$ 的下界。从消极方面来看，我们证明了（摘要在此处不完整）
tldr: 该论文为两阶段结构化Hadamard旋转逼近高维均匀随机旋转建立了首个非渐近理论保证，证明了坐标分布距离的 $\sqrt{\log d/d}$ 阶一致上界以及 $d^{-1/2}$ 阶下界。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes the first nonasymptotic theoretical guarantees for two-stage structured Hadamard rotations approximating uniform random rotations in high dimensions, proving uniform upper bounds of order $\sqrt{\log d/d}$ and lower bounds of order $d^{-1/2}$ in coordinate-wise Kolmogorov and Wasserstein-1 distances.
